status: DRAFT - not registered. Becomes the registration when committed with status 'registered', before any timed run.
recording: not recorded by the team runtime; self-recorded manifests
queries: 500 calibration queries only, file order; held-out untouched
fixed: range_scores kernel body (variant 5), index format, scoring, selection, merge; range size 1024 positions, 256 threads

implementations.sequential: control: one query at a time, each on its own slot and stream
implementations.streams: all queries of a batch launched before any is collected, one stream per query
implementations.batched: one launch per batch, grid (ranges, batch), last block detected per query

later: full collection once the shared index is published; a new registration entry is added before those runs

correctness_gate.rule: both must pass from the timed source commit on the timed GPU model; any mismatch or failure stops before timing and is reported

timing.order: rotating across the three processes: in process p configuration (i + offset_p) mod n runs i-th, offsets 0, ceil(n/3), ceil(2n/3)
timing.batch_formation: consecutive queries in file order; the last batch may be partial; batches are complete before timing starts, so no wait-to-form time is included or modelled
timing.boundary: per batch: host build of query arguments, query transfer (kernel argument for sequential/streams, one H2D copy for batched), all kernels, top-k D2H to pinned memory, event completion; index, tie-rank and buffer setup excluded
timing.gpu_check: wait for no other compute process on the GPU before each process (poll 60 s, abort after 60 min); 2-second GPU process sampler with other users' paths redacted; GPU UUID, source commit and index SHA-256 pinned in every manifest
timing.correctness_during_timing: every saved top-k of every process compared with the CPU oracle

metrics.throughput_qps: queries / sum of batch_wall_ms over a measured round, per process; reported per configuration as the median over rounds and processes with the range
metrics.completion_latency_ms: per query, from batch start to that query's results on the host; reported as median, p95 and p99 over queries, per configuration
metrics.batch_processing_ms: batch_wall_ms per full batch; partial batches reported separately
metrics.peak_gpu_memory: shared index bytes, per-query slot bytes x batch, and device used-memory delta after all allocations, from the driver; reported separately from time

contrasts: streams / sequential and batched / sequential throughput at each batch size and k
batched / streams throughput at each batch size and k
each mode at batch b / the same mode at batch 1
analysis: paired by measured round and process; geometric mean of throughput ratios; 10,000-draw bootstrap over rounds and processes, fixed seed recorded in the analysis script; completion-latency percentiles are descriptive
hardware: primary: one RTX 2080 Ti (sm_75) on cuda2, labelled as such; RTX 4070 (sm_89) only after agreeing a slot with the team. Results from different GPU models are never pooled.
not_in_this_registration: held-out queries, arrival processes or batch-formation wait, multi-GPU, changes to scoring/selection/storage, pruning
